Q. কতটুকু কাজ সম্পন্ন হবে?
explanation: $\begin{aligned} \omega & =\frac{1}{2}-\frac{Y A l^2}{\mathrm{~L}} \\ & =\frac{1.24 \times 10^{11} \mathrm{Nm}^{-2} \times 1 \times 10^{-2} \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~m}^2 \times\left(.2 \times 10^{-2} \mathrm{~m}\right)^2}{2 \times 1 \mathrm{~m}} \\ & =0.248 \mathrm{~J}\end{aligned}$
